The '''H-7 "Equalizer"''' was one of the best [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], produced by [[Coronet Arms/Legends|Coronet Arms]] and occasionally used by [[Inspector/Legends|CorSec Inspectors]] and [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]].
